subject: Preservation windows & SOC 2 evidence for customer-specific deletion requests

Subject: Questions on deletion timelines & SOC 2 evidence for TheraHealth request

Hi Neha / Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — TheraHealth has an urgent auditor request. We submitted a formal deletion request for a set of customer records (ticket TH-2026-0410) and need to confirm a few items to satisfy our auditor: 

- Exact preservation windows for request logs, transactional logs, and backups once a deletion request is accepted by Redwood.
- Whether Redwood can provide a customer-specific attestation that backups will be overwritten/rotated within a defined window (we requested 45 days).
- A pointer to the SOC 2 controls (or excerpt) that describe data disposal and backup retention so we can attach to our SOC review.

Can you also confirm if there are any circumstances (legal hold, fraud investigations, regulatory holds) that would prevent immediate removal? Our auditor wants a signed attestation we can keep on file.

I've attached our SIG questionnaire subset (TheraHealth-SIG-questions-20260412.xlsx) with the specific data points highlighted. Could we aim for a short call this week if helpful?

Appreciate the help — Elena

Elena / team — thanks, reviewed the SIG extract you sent. Below is a concise summary of Redwood's standard behavior and what we can offer for a customer-specific deletion attestation. I attached our internal deletion policy and the SOC 2 excerpt for controls mapping.

Summary (standard preservation windows):
- Primary (live) customer data: removed from the primary datastore within 72 hours of authorization for a validated deletion request. Purge is irreversible for primary copies.
- Request & audit logs (application-level): retained in hot logs for 30 days by default. Logs older than 30 days are rolled to a cold store and retained in immutable archives for up to 180 days unless otherwise requested.
- Backups / disaster recovery snapshots: rotated on a 45–90 day schedule depending on the backup tier. Standard baseline is 60 days.

What we can commit for TheraHealth (one-off attestation options):
- We can provide a signed attestation that primary data will be purged within 72 hours after authorization.
- For backups, we can commit to a specific rotation window of 45 days for records covered by this request provided TheraHealth executes a brief amendment (Data Erasure Exception Authorization) and a billing/POA confirmation. This is operationally feasible but requires an approved ticket and legal sign-off.
- We can provide a CAIQ/SIG mapping and the SOC 2 excerpt (see attached) that point to our logical disposal and backup controls.

Limitations / holds:
- Redwood will not perform data deletion if there is an active legal/regulatory hold, an open internal fraud/security investigation tied to the records, or a court order. Those holds must be disclosed to the customer during intake.

Attached: redwood-deletion-policy-v2.pdf, soc2-audit-excerpt-2025.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) TheraHealth confirms they will sign the Data Erasure Exception Authorization (we can provide template).
2) Customer PM/POA confirms the ticket (TH-2026-0410) and approves the 45-day backup rotation commitment.
3) We provide the signed attestation + SOC 2 excerpt and CAIQ answers that Elena can attach to your audit package.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call Tuesday to walk the auditor through the SOC 2 mapping.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena.park@therahealth.com>

Neha — this is very helpful, thank you. A couple of clarifications before we get legal sign-off on the amendment: 

1) For the SOC 2 excerpt, can you point to the specific control IDs (e.g., CC6.x / CC7.x) that map to disposal and backup rotation? Our auditor requires control-level citations.
2) For the 45-day backup commitment, will Redwood provide a time-stamped attestation stating: "Backups containing TheraHealth customer data related to deletion request TH-2026-0410 will be overwritten or irrecoverably rotated within 45 calendar days of attestation signature."

We need the attestation signed by an authorized Redwood officer (legal or security). We will attach the signed attestation plus the SOC 2 excerpt to our internal audit binder. If you can get a draft attestation and the control mapping today, we can route on our side for signatures.

Thanks — Elena

Also attaching a draft Data Erasure Attestation template (data-erasure-attestation-template.docx) that our legal team will sign once the POA/authorization is in place.

Quick notes on the controls mapping (high level):
- Control mapping: CC6.1 (logical access and data lifecycle) and CC7.2 (system operations & backup management) are the primary controls that cover disposal & backup lifecycle in our SOC 2. The excerpt includes the auditor narrative and test results for those controls.
- The attestation will be signed by our General Counsel or Security Head depending on the language; we typically have Legal (Laura) sign attestation letters that are contract-adjacent.
